Invitation.description:
An open invitation; ``epoch`` is the place's removal epoch, so an accept after a removal
is refused by the app.
Invitation.title: Invitation

ParentPlace.description:
The place a standing's place lies inside: ``app`` is the parent app's MCP resource URL and
``place`` the place there. A runner compares both with a place it holds, ``app`` as a parsed
URL, so equal addresses in another spelling match; the record grants nothing.
ParentPlace.title: ParentPlace

PlaceRef.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.
PlaceRef.title: PlaceRef

Standing.description: One place, the member's state there and, exactly when invited, the invitation.
Standing.title: Standing

MemberStanding.description: Every place the member is in at the moment it was read; a place left is absent.
MemberStanding.title: MemberStanding

PlaceView.description:
The state of one place for the member, as the app serves it.

``state`` is the app's document, carried untouched and never read here. ``revision`` changes
whenever the place moves on for this member, that is whenever what the member may do or must
act on changes; parts of ``state`` that say only who is present may change without it.
``awaits_you`` says the place waits for this member to act; the app decides it from the state
at that revision, so one revision has one ``awaits_you``. ``traceparent`` is the trace the
revision moved in, which a runner continues in the turn it wakes.
PlaceView.title: PlaceView

HoldPlace.description:
Where a hold stopped the member.

``in_sentence`` requires the ``sentence`` the hold stopped before its end, and says with
``heard_to`` how far every seat heard it: ``0 <= heard_to < len(sentence)`` in code points,
where 0 means not every seat heard a word; absent, the app cannot tell. ``between_sentences``
carries neither field. That ``heard_to`` falls on a word's end is the app's duty.
HoldPlace.title: HoldPlace

HoldPoint.description:
Where a hold stopped the member: ``in_sentence``, before the end of a sentence that answered
``Spoken``, or ``between_sentences``, when no such sentence was playing or the playing one
played to its end. A sentence still rendering counts as waiting.
HoldPoint.title: HoldPoint

Interrupted.description:
The member is held: a person talked over it, and nothing of the member plays until its
decision. ``id`` is the app's, never repeats within the window's ``generation`` and stays
fixed while the hold stands; ``continue_speaking``, ``stop_speaking`` and ``speak`` name it.
The hold ends at one of them, or at the member's or the place's end. ``place`` says where
the hold stopped the member and stays as it was while the hold stands; it is absent while
the app states none. ``wordless`` is true from the change that adds the hold while no word
(``has_words``) of its talk-over has been heard; the app then owns the hold's end and ends it
by itself (``PlaceWindow.went_on``), and a runner starts no decision for it. It leaves in
the change in which the first word is heard, and never returns for this ``id``; it is
absent while false. ``worded_changes`` counts the partials and lines of the talk-over's people
whose words (``words_of``) differ from what that person was last heard to say; it states the
count from the change in which the first word is heard, only rises, and is absent while the
app states none. A choice names the count its decision was told as ``told_changes``.
Interrupted.title: Interrupted

PartialSpeech.description:
What one person has said so far in an utterance that is not finished; provisional, never a
line. ``text`` is empty while the person has started and said no words yet.
PartialSpeech.title: PartialSpeech

PlaceEntry.description:
One line of a place; ``kind`` is the app's own text, ``own`` marks the member's line and
``spoken`` a line said aloud and heard, one finished utterance, rather than written. A line
enters once its sentence has ended and is never changed; ``cut`` marks a spoken sentence cut
before its end, whose ``text`` is the part heard up to the cut, or the whole sentence when the
app cannot tell how far it played. ``act`` marks a written line that says what someone did
rather than what someone said: it is told and never calls the member to act. ``continues``
marks a spoken line whose speaker's next sentence at the place already waits to play as the
line enters; the app copies that fact and decides nothing on it. ``language`` is the ISO 639-1
code a spoken line was heard in; absent, the app names none. ``traceparent`` is the trace the
line entered in, which a runner continues in the turn the line wakes.
PlaceEntry.title: PlaceEntry

TalkedOver.description:
People talk over the member. ``id`` is the app's, never repeats within the window's
``generation`` and stays fixed from the record's appearance to its removal, so a runner takes
one decision per ``id``; a second person who starts speaking adds a ``PartialSpeech`` under
the same ``id``. ``playing`` says some sentence of the member plays at the place now. ``speech``
lists the people in the order they started speaking.
TalkedOver.title: TalkedOver

VoiceState.description:
Whether the member's voice at the place has failed for that member there: ``available``
while the app's voice works, ``unavailable`` while it has failed, so a ``speak`` would not be
voiced for that reason. A social reason or a limit of the app never changes it.
VoiceState.title: VoiceState

WentOn.description:
A hold through whose talk-over no word was heard ended by itself and the member went on:
``id`` is that hold's ``Interrupted.id``.
WentOn.title: WentOn

PlaceWindow.description:
The lines of one place from ``starts_at`` on, in ascending ``seq``; ``seq`` may skip.

``generation`` names the run of ``seq`` numbers the window belongs to. An empty window is
valid, and its ``starts_at`` is the ``seq`` the next line will get. ``talked_over`` is set
only while people talk over the member; a person's partial and finished line are never both
in one read. ``interrupted`` is set exactly while the member is held, and leaves in the same
change that ends the hold; a new ``generation`` carries none. ``went_on`` names the latest hold
of this ``generation`` that ended by itself; it arises in the change that ends that hold and
stays until a later one replaces it. ``voice_state`` states a failure of the member's voice at
the place, for that member there; absent, the app states nothing.
PlaceWindow.title: PlaceWindow

arguments.description:
The arguments of ``accept_invitation``: the place and the invitation's id and epoch, and
optionally the agent's ``looks``, first choice first, its ``figure`` and its ``voices``, the
names of the voices it would speak with, first choice first; an absent one means the app's own
default. The app shows the first look it can; ``figure`` is read only while ``looks`` is
absent. The app passes the ``voices`` unchanged and in order to its speech service, which
picks the voice.

anyOf.description:
Where an agent's 3D figure is (see ``HttpsFileRef``) and, optionally, its own clips: for a
gesture of figure's base set, the file that replaces figure's neutral clip on this figure
only. A gesture has at most one clip, and ``gestures`` is left out of the JSON when empty.

additionalProperties.description:
Where a file is and the digest its bytes must have: ``url`` is an absolute ``https``
address with a host and no user part, query or fragment, and ``sha256`` is 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. The record checks the form only; whether to fetch the file is the
app's decision.

oneOf.description:
A look of the agent that is its 3D figure: the fields of ``FigureRef`` and ``kind``, the
``figure`` tag that tells the look from a ``VideoLook``, and, optionally, ``room``, the agent's
own room, which an app hands to figure to draw behind the figure; left out of the JSON when
unset. ``FigureRef``, so the old ``figure``, carries no room. A figure look plays gestures.

additionalProperties.description:
Where a file is and the digest its bytes must have: ``url`` is an absolute ``https``
address with a host and no user part, query or fragment, and ``sha256`` is 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. The record checks the form only; whether to fetch the file is the
app's decision.

anyOf.description:
Where a file is and the digest its bytes must have: ``url`` is an absolute ``https``
address with a host and no user part, query or fragment, and ``sha256`` is 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. The record checks the form only; whether to fetch the file is the
app's decision.

oneOf.description:
A look of the agent that a video service renders, named by ``name``: the app's video
service decides which look the name stands for.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

AcceptInvitationRefusal.description:
Why the app does not accept an invitation: ``stale_invitation`` when the invitation is no
longer standing, has expired, or its id or epoch no longer matches, or the member holds no
lease; ``two_seats`` when the person who brought the member does not hold exactly
one seat in the place, the inviting one; ``sponsor_away`` when that person's seat lost its
connection and waits to resume; ``busy`` when the place has no free seat.
AcceptInvitationRefusal.title: AcceptInvitationRefusal

results.description: What ``accept_invitation`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: AcceptInvitationRefused

arguments.description:
The arguments of ``continue_speaking``: the place and the hold (``PlaceWindow.interrupted``)
whose held sentence goes on. With ``finish``, only the held sentence's rest plays and the queue
is dropped, each dropped ``speak`` answering ``stopped``; absent while false, the queue plays
too. ``told_changes`` is the ``Interrupted.worded_changes`` the runner's decision was told;
absent, the app does not check it.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

results.description:
What ``continue_speaking`` answers on success, as JSON, when the held sentence's rest plays
on, faded back in, then the queue unless the call finished: the answer comes when it plays,
which waits until no person of the hold's talk-over speaks; the field is exactly the JSON
``true``.
results.title: ContinuedSpeaking

ContinueSpeakingRefusal.description:
Why the app does not continue: ``not_active`` when the member left, was removed or is
paused; ``not_interrupted`` when ``interrupted`` names a hold that does not stand, or a
waiting call that a later choice, a stop or a voice that went on voided; ``stale`` when
``told_changes`` is below the ``worded_changes`` the app counted.
ContinueSpeakingRefusal.title: ContinueSpeakingRefusal

results.description: What ``continue_speaking`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: ContinueSpeakingRefused

arguments.description:
The arguments of ``decline_invitation``: the place, the invitation's id and epoch, and the
reason; a decline needs no lease, as it seats nothing.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

reason.description:
Why the runner declines an invitation: ``busy`` when the runner is at its own limit of how
many places it is in at once; not ``AcceptInvitationRefusal.BUSY``, which is the app's full
place.

DeclineInvitationRefusal.description:
Why the app does not take a decline: ``stale_invitation`` when the invitation is not that
member's, no longer stands, has expired, or its id or epoch no longer matches.
DeclineInvitationRefusal.title: DeclineInvitationRefusal

results.description: What ``decline_invitation`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: DeclineInvitationRefused

arguments.description: The place and the gesture your figure makes there.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

results.description:
What ``gesture`` answers, as JSON and without ``is_error``, when the app has handed the
gesture to the people at the place; the field is exactly the JSON ``true``. It does not say
that a page played it.
results.title: Relayed

GestureRefusal.description:
Why the app does not relay a gesture: ``not_active`` when the member left, was removed or
is paused.
GestureRefusal.title: GestureRefusal

results.description: What ``gesture`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: GestureRefused

arguments.description:
The place and the framing your figure takes there: how much of you the people see, from your
face to your whole body. The framing stays until you set another.

framing.description: A framing of how much of itself figure shows.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

SetFramingRefusal.description:
Why the app does not take a framing: ``not_active`` when the member left, was removed or is
paused.
SetFramingRefusal.title: SetFramingRefusal

results.description: What ``set_framing`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: SetFramingRefused

arguments.description:
The arguments of ``set_turn_state``: the place and why the member's turns there stop; an
absent ``stopped`` states that they answer. The value is a closed outcome, never free text.
``thinking`` states instead that a turn is running there; it does not fit with ``stopped``.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

anyOf.description: What a stopped turn means to a person; an app words only this, never the code.

SetTurnStateRefusal.description:
Why the app does not take a statement: ``not_held`` when the caller holds no seat, active or
paused, at the place.
SetTurnStateRefusal.title: SetTurnStateRefusal

results.description: What ``set_turn_state`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: SetTurnStateRefused

arguments.description:
The arguments of ``speak``: the place and one sentence, whose length the app bounds, and
optionally the ``language`` of that sentence, the ``style`` it should sound in, which the app
passes on unchanged, and the ``mood`` the agent's figure shows while it speaks; an absent one
means the app's own default, and an app that draws no figure ignores the ``mood``.
``interrupted`` names the hold (``PlaceWindow.interrupted``) the sentence answers instead of
the held rest; without it, a held member refuses the sentence. ``keeps_queue``, valid only with
``interrupted``, makes the sentence a short own line: it takes the head of the queue and the
queued sentences stay behind it, none of them answering ``stopped``; absent while false, the
sentence replaces the queue. An app that does not declare it leaves the queue to ``stopped``.
``told_changes``, valid only with ``interrupted``, is the ``Interrupted.worded_changes`` the
runner's decision was told; absent, the app does not check it.

anyOf.description: A mood figure can show on a face.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

results.description:
What ``speak`` answers, as JSON and without ``is_error``, when the sentence starts to play;
the field is exactly the JSON ``true``. It carries no length: the sentence's end reaches the
member as its own line in the window, or, when not every seat heard a word of it, through the
hold's place or the stop's answer.
results.title: Spoken

results.description:
What ``speak`` answers, as JSON and without ``is_error``, when the app could not voice the
sentence for a failure of its voice and posted it at the place as the member's written line
instead; the field is exactly the JSON ``true``.
results.title: Written

SpeakRefusal.description:
Why the app does not speak a sentence: ``language_unavailable`` when the app's voice does
not speak the language the sentence names, ``style_unavailable`` for every refusal of the
``style`` by the voice (it takes none, it is too long or it is not supported), ``stopped``
for a queued sentence that a ``stop_speaking`` or a ``speak`` naming the hold dropped,
``held`` when the member is held and the sentence names no hold, ``not_interrupted`` when the
sentence names a hold that does not stand or its waiting choice was voided or replaced,
``stale`` when the sentence's ``told_changes`` is below the ``worded_changes`` the app
counted, and ``unavailable`` when the app neither voices nor writes the sentence now: a
social reason, a limit of its own or a failed voice at a place without a chat. ``held`` and
``stale`` change nothing and answer at once, as does ``not_interrupted`` for a hold that does
not stand. No refusal is ever turned into a written line.
SpeakRefusal.title: SpeakRefusal

results.description: What ``speak`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: SpeakRefused

arguments.description:
The arguments of ``stop_speaking``: the place whose sentence and queue of the member are
cut, and optionally ``interrupted``, the hold (``PlaceWindow.interrupted``) the stop ends; one
that does not stand is refused. ``told_changes`` is the ``Interrupted.worded_changes`` the
runner's decision was told; absent, the app does not check it.

place.description: A place the member is in, opaque to everyone but the app: its kind and its id.

results.description:
What ``stop_speaking`` answers when a cut line entered, as JSON: the text of the cut
sentence's line, the heard part when the app knows it, else the whole sentence.
results.title: StoppedSpeaking

results.description:
What ``stop_speaking`` answers, as JSON, when no cut line entered: it dropped a held
sentence that had not started or that not every seat heard a word of, or a playing one cut
before that, or the queue; the field is exactly the JSON ``true``.
results.title: DroppedSpeaking

StopSpeakingRefusal.title: StopSpeakingRefusal

results.description: What ``stop_speaking`` answers on a refusal, as JSON in an ``is_error`` result.
results.title: StopSpeakingRefused
